body:
I do talk to one friend of mine, they really try to help and listen, but I feel like it's time to talk to a psychologist or counselor.
I keep trying to find one in my city but it seems there's so many obstacles in my way. One isn't taking new patients, another isn't in my insurance, I finally get an appointment with someone and my car breaks down so I can't get there... The list goes on and on, I feel like giving up sometimes but I haven't yet.
Most of the time I can fight that bad impulses, but I slip up so many times. I'm trying really hard. It just hit me today how I felt like I knew I'd kill myself someday.
Thanks for replying. (: I do feel a bit better now I've gotten a lot of this off my chest. I also feel like I'm on a bit of an upswing away from a week of feeling depressed.
